changelog:
A playing channel now stays on while you browse, docked above the tabs, and diagnostic mode shows what the player is doing, second by second.

WHAT CHANGED

- Back from the player no longer stops the channel. It docks it as a small bar above the tabs, with the live picture, its name, play or pause, and close. Tap the bar to go back to full screen; close stops it. Picking another channel while one is docked starts it fresh.
- Diagnostic mode (Settings, Diagnostics) shows a statistics panel over the player: the decoder and whether it is hardware or software, the picture size, the frame rate, dropped frames, the bitrate and how much is buffered. Each multi-view cell shows a short version, and a cell made full screen shows the whole panel. A figure past its limit is coloured, and the same figures go to the log once a second.
- A channel that reconnects while in picture-in-picture is decoded in software, so it can come back without a screen of its own.
- The app is built with current Android libraries (Compose, navigation, networking and others), and with the Android 17 tools.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything from 0.5.14.2: choosing and pinning a channel's guide, matching by a playlist's second name, and long-press offering the guide on every live channel.
